title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes the US session at $79,590, up 3.1 percent, with greed firmly in control at a Fear and Greed reading of 74. 

Hashrate holds steady near 880 EH/s while the mempool clears 81,000 transactions at minimal 1 sat per vbyte fees. Block height advances to 963,938. 

Key takeaway: buyers are absorbing supply without spiking costs, keeping the network efficient. Watch for overnight momentum shifts as thin volume data leaves room for quick reversals into Asia trading.
